description: This bar chart illustrates the popularity scores for four large language models – Llama3, Qwen2, ChatGPT, and Acc=0 & GT Ans – across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball”, in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Four bars are present for each category, each representing one of the language models, distinguished by color: Llama3 is blue, Qwen2 is orange, ChatGPT is red, and Acc=0 & GT Ans is patterned with diagonal lines. For the “Movies” category, the bar heights are approximately 24 for Llama3, 30 for Qwen2, 28 for ChatGPT, and 14 for Acc=0 & GT Ans. In the “Songs” category, the bar heights are approximately 60 for Llama3, 66 for Qwen2, 72 for ChatGPT, and 36 for Acc=0 & GT Ans. For “Basketball”, the bar heights are approximately 104 for Llama3, 90 for Qwen2, 186 for ChatGPT, and 68 for Acc=0 & GT Ans. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each category, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
